title: GitHub Actions jobs fail at once with a payment or spending-limit message
why:
[00:13 CST Nov 16, triage] Coordinator relay 00:14 CST, from runner 12's read: ios-adblock #175 `checks` job 133125009327 (run 43815026279) failed in 31 s with no runner: "recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased". Confirmed in ios-adblock only; claude-settings not confirmed by the coordinator's REST read (no billing annotation; some runs queued). Only the account owner reaches GitHub Billing & plans (github.com/settings/billing). Page task item 916 asks for the check. (source: runner 12 via the coordinator; not owner-typed)

[00:21 CST Nov 16, triage] Update (coordinator relay 00:21 CST, runner 12's REST read): confirmed in two repos, ios-adblock #175 and joyous #92 (payment or spending-limit note, 0 steps, no runner). Banchi #1105: 12 jobs queued, none started. claude-settings: not annotated; #3535's `checks` run 43815678056 pending with no jobs since 06:16:54Z UTC, other PR runs queued; consistent, unproven. Runner 12 stopped marking PRs ready until it clears.

[00:34 CST Nov 16, triage] Coordinator relay 00:34 CST (runner 12's REST re-read): jobs start again as of 06:28Z; banchi #1105 jobs finished success; the ios-adblock #175 and joyous #92 failures were old and re-run; claude-settings #3535 run 43815678056 started at about 00:33 CST. Cause unproven (queue delay, or Billing & plans cleared). Coordinator pick: step to watching; page item 916 stays open without `holds`; reopen as blocking if a job fails again with 0 steps. Not owner-typed; undoable.

[00:54 CST Nov 16, triage] Coordinator correction (relay 00:5x CST, runner 12's REST read at 00:51 CST): billing is NOT cleared for the two private repos. ios-adblock and joyous re-runs (attempt 2, started 06:33Z) failed again with 0 steps and the billing annotation; ios-adblock #175, joyous #92 and #94 cannot run CI until the owner clears GitHub Billing & plans. Banchi (public) and claude-settings jobs run and pass. Coordinator pick, undoing its 00:34 CST pick: step back to blocked, scoped to those two private repos; page item 916 holds restored. Not owner-typed; undoable.
source: runner 12 via the coordinator, 00:14 CST Nov 16; filed by triage 8
note: Blocked on the owner, for ios-adblock and joyous only: their CI jobs fail with 0 steps and the billing message (runner 12, 00:51 CST Nov 16), so none of their PRs can merge. Banchi and claude-settings run and pass. Only the owner clears GitHub Billing & plans (page item 916). No PR.
